title: Hamiltonian Two-Way Coupling of Nonlinear Waves and 3D Flows
summary: Simulating large-scale free-surface water by coupling a localized 3D fluid solver to a cheaper 2D surface model has long faced a mismatch in wave dynamics: efficient 2D wave models used in graphics are typically either linear or non-dispersive. These models are fast, simple, and accurate for calm, small-amplitude seas, but coupling them with strongly nonlinear 3D solvers produces visible reflections and artifacts at the 2D--3D interface.
